message: Megatron 70B on one 8x H200 node (TP8, any recompute, bf16 main grads and moments, no offload): OOM
fix: FSDP2 + AdamW8bit + full AC (804-1116 tok/s/GPU), or the CPU-optimizer offload (139)

text: same config, H200-class vs H20 (single node): expect ~3.2x per-GPU throughput, not the 6.7x peak ratio; real GEMM ratio is ~5x and ~1/3 is lost to non-GEMM work. Measured: median 3.23x over 173 pairs (0.96-7.97); H200 6N-MFU 0.3-0.6 vs H20 0.7-1.1.

tensor parallelism on H200 (NVLink unchanged, compute x5): prefer TP1/TP2 + DP/FSDP; TP4/TP8 only to fit memory. Measured: 8B TP1/2/4/8 = 1 / 0.89 / 0.61 / 0.32 (H20 1 / 0.96 / 0.90 / 0.79); 14B TP8 0.54x TP2; TP8 pairs 2.3x H20.

FP8 (TE delayed/tensorwise) on H200: FP8 still helps at TP1/TP2 with large GEMMs, but expect half the H20 gain; avoid FP8 at TP8 and with recompute. Measured: 8B best +30 % (H20 +58 %); TP2 +3 %; TP8 -20 %; FP8+recompute -38 % vs FP8 (H20 -21 %); 14B TP2 +42 %; FP8 pairs 2.3x H20.
TE FP8 dot-product attention on H200: do not enable (cuDNN bf16 attention is already 449-528 TFLOPS). Measured: 4k -8 %, 32k +-0 %, best-8B -1.5 %, 32B -11 % (H20 +6 % / +28 %).

141 GB per GPU: drop recompute / raise mbs where H20 could not; 70B Megatron still does not fit one node. Measured: 32B TP4/TP2xPP2 no recompute; MoE FP8 single node; 8B 32k CP8 TP1 no recompute 5337; full Qwen3.6-35B-A3B fp32 Adam 1666; 70B TP8 OOM even with full recompute + bf16 states; 128k without recompute OOM.

overhead-bound workloads: do not expect GPU-generation gains for HF+LoRA, HF-implemented MoE, CPU offload. Measured: HF Trainer+LoRA 1.71x; HF MoE hybrid 1.39-2.11x; CPU offload 1.25-1.86x; QLoRA 0.84x of bf16 LoRA (H20 0.93x).
activation recompute: same tax as H20; selective almost free. Measured: full -21 % (H20 -22 %), selective -4 %.
best 8B single-node config: TP1 DP8 + FP8 delayed + bf16 main grads, mbs2. Measured: 13043 tok/s/GPU (mbs1 12246; mbs4 OOM); 8k 11947; 16k (CP2) 9709.

70B full fine-tune on one 8-GPU H200 node: FSDP2 + full AC + torchao AdamW8bit (+ float8 + compile); not Megatron. Measured: 804 -> 1116 tok/s/GPU (MFU 0.48) at 115 GB; Megatron CPU-optimizer offload 139; same FSDP2 config OOMs on 96 GB H20.
32B single node: TP4 FP8 + bf16 main grads, no recompute. Measured: 2407 > TP2 + bf16 states 2256 > TP4 bf16 2011 > TP2xPP2 1971 > TP8 1516; with recompute TP2xPP4 1425 > TP8 1053.
full-depth hybrid GDN architectures: fit on H200 with fp32 Adam + full AC. Measured: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 1666 (H20 OOM); Qwen3.8-27B 1699 (3.05x H20).

torch.compile / async TP on H200: always compile (bigger win than on H20); async TP only at TP>=4. Measured: titan TP2 eager -> compile +40 % (H20 +5 %); FSDP2 +24 % (H20 +10 %); LitGPT +28 %; MoE only +5 %; async TP TP2 +0 %, TP4 +3.4 %.
torchtitan PP vs FSDP on one node: PP2 (ZBV) x FSDP4 beats FSDP8 on H200. Measured: 1.09x (H20 0.99x); 1F1B 0.98x (H20 0.89x).

where step time goes on H200 (device-kernel share; annotations excluded): communication and glue kernels matter: optimize overlap, fusion, batch size before GEMMs. Measured: Megatron 8B TP2 GEMM 51 % / NCCL 21 % (H20 76 / 6); FSDP2 36 / 28 (67 / 10); torchao FP8+compile: GEMM incl. FP8 33 %, NCCL 35 %, elementwise 16 % -> FP8 speeds up only a third of kernel time.

other low-precision options on H200: prune blockwise FP8 (Triton), MoE float8 grouped GEMM. Measured: blockwise FP8 eager 0.85x bf16 (H20 1.43x); rowwise_with_gw_hp 0.94x tensorwise; MoE float8 grouped GEMM 0.55x.

layout details on H200: MoE: EP8 + grouped GEMM + permute fusion off; attention: cuDNN backend. Measured: EP4xTP2 0.48x EP8; no grouped GEMM 0.67x; permute fusion off +5 %; FA2 -17 % at 32k; gbs 8 -> 64 +16 % (H20 +5 %).

kernel-level FP8 and GDN on H200: expect 1.5-1.7x FP8/bf16 at the GEMM level (H20 1.9x); linear-attention kernels gain only 1.35-1.67x over H20. Measured: TE Linear bf16 672-743 vs FP8 delayed 1014-1264 TFLOPS; GDN 4.5 vs 2.7 Mtok/s.

codebase choice for an 8B dense model on one 8x H200 node (bf16, no recompute): Megatron or any FSDP framework WITH torch.compile; eager FSDP frameworks lose ~20 %. Measured: Megatron 8811 (9390 bf16 grads); LitGPT/Fabric FSDP1 7094 -> 9052 compiled; torchtitan 8282 -> 8998; HF+FSDP2 7004 -> 8684; HF Trainer 7235-7320; DeepSpeed ZeRO-1/2/3 7731/7373/6564.
